explication: Levanter is a multi-session WhatsApp bot with a plugin-driven command surface and an optional authenticated HTTP/webhook API. Its principal workflow starts the configured instance, connects WhatsApp sessions, handles user commands through plugins, and returns replies or performs group/media actions. The README also documents API sends, session listing, media retrieval and incoming-message webhooks. Source excerpts establish startup and several plugin-to-library calls; most client, API and handler internals were not sampled, so their detailed dispatch and persistence links are intentionally limited.
